bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Relays the remote service's own result unchanged; it computes no number of its own, so the service is the authority for what comes back.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does the authority named return for this gene or genomic region?

description: Look up a gene or genomic region: NCBI Gene records, HGNC nomenclature, Ensembl records, cross-references, MyGene identifiers, UCSC assembly data, GTEx expression, or BioMart tables.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

query.description: a gene symbol or identifier (e.g. "BRCA2"), or a command such as "ensembl_lookup:BRCA2" or "ensembl_xrefs:ENSG00000139618".

name: lookup_gene

count.description: how many records came back, which is a result even when it is zero

envelope.description: the authority's whole answer: paging, totals and the query it actually ran

provenance.description: the authority, the exact endpoints called and when — what makes an answer re-checkable without re-running it

records.description: the records the authority returned, in its own field names — wire them into a tool that takes ids, or read them in the transcript
